display_name: Usage KPI row as chart control
implementation_state: Usage KPI row (请求数/成功率/缓存命中率/Token/预估花费) under a period-frame lede; request-count and Token cells drive the traffic chart (two-way with the in-chart segment, single state owner in Activity); success/hit/spend are deliberate readouts; hit rate = sum(per_model.cached_tokens)/sum(per_model.input_tokens) with ? = formula tooltip; denominator zero renders an em dash while zero hits with traffic render 0%.
unblock_condition: Five KPI figures render; clicking one switches the traffic chart metric; hit-rate tooltip states its formula; missing cache-write data renders N/A, not zero.
notes: Design source: cc-switch UsageHero selected/onSelect (docs/development/cc-switch-design-notes.md §1), tightened by an honesty rule: the per-day ledger has no cost/cache series, so only requests/tokens became controllers.
Backend note: get_usage_days carrying cost/cache columns would let all five cells drive the chart — a [B] suggestion for the Rust owner.
